title: Tofu Pho Curry
description: A fusion of Indian and Vietnamese flavors in a rich and creamy curry. Serve over fluffy basmati rice or with some crispy salty naan.

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: use a sweet onion like vidalia

instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, and turmeric and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the pho seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 10-15 minutes.
Serve over fluffy basmati rice or with some crispy salty naan.
